pathAssistantSteps.info:
Our goals are now to:

  • make contact with the person
  • confirm there is mutual interest in moving forwards
  • book the first meeting to get more details

Learn about and contact your new lead quickly.


Respond to your lead within five minutes to increase your chances of being able to successfully meet the customer's need.

  • Look at the customer profile to familiarise yourself with them as a individual before contacting them.
  • Understand what we already know about their goals, life stage, financial situation.
  • Check their recent activity to see if they have been browsing our website and what topics they have spent the most time looking at.
This means that there is no immediate interest in moving forwards and so we'll leave them at Nurturing stage and drip feed them marketing material.
